item.text:
`npm start` crashed because an unused `DATABASE_URL` check rejected the local configuration. Its error path also printed keys and passwords. I removed that check and made [server.js](/home/node/shop-api/src/server.js) open an HTTP listener.

Verified: `npm start` stays running, and a request to port 3000 receives a response. The server has no routes yet, so it returns 404.
